# SIB Infotech

> SIB Infotech (founded in 2005) is an award-winning, full-service Digital Marketing Agency, Premier SEO Company, Google Premier Partner PPC Firm, and Custom Web & Mobile Application Development Company headquartered in Mumbai and New Delhi, India. SIB Infotech provides ROI-driven digital solutions to 1,500+ businesses across India, USA, UK, Australia, UAE, Canada, and Europe.

- **Client Retention Rate**: 98%

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & AI Search
SIB Infotech delivers end-to-end technical, on-page, off-page, local, and AI-driven search engine optimization to achieve top organic rankings on Google, Bing, and AI Answer Engines.
- [SEO Services Company in India](https://www.sibinfotech.com/seo-company-mumbai): Comprehensive ROI-focused SEO strategies that drive qualified organic traffic and high-converting keyword rankings.
- [AI SEO Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/ai-seo-services): Next-generation search optimization powered by AI analytics, automated content intelligence, and entity-first optimization.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://www.sibinfotech.com/answer-engine-optimization): Structured data and conversational search optimization to rank in Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Copilot.
- [Local SEO Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/local-seo-services): Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization, local map pack rankings, citation building, and multi-location local search marketing.
- [Ecommerce SEO Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/ecommerce-seo-services): Category & product page optimization, faceted navigation indexing, structured schema, and revenue-driven e-commerce SEO.
- [Enterprise SEO Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/enterprise-seo-services): Scalable enterprise-grade SEO architecture for websites with 10,000+ pages.
- [Technical SEO Audit Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/technical-seo-services): In-depth Core Web Vitals optimization, crawl budget analysis, indexation fixes, JavaScript SEO, and XML sitemap architecture.
- [Google Penalty Recovery Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/google-penalty-recovery-services): Identification and recovery from Google algorithmic updates (Core, Helpful Content, Spam, Reviews) and manual actions.
- [Link Building Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/link-building-services): High-domain authority contextual editorial link acquisition and digital PR outreach.
- [SEO Packages](https://www.sibinfotech.com/search-engine-optimization-seo-packages): Transparent, affordable monthly SEO plans tailored for startups, SMEs, and global enterprises.

### 2. Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising & Performance Marketing
As an official Google Premier Partner and Meta Partner, SIB Infotech manages high-performing paid media budgets with proven ROAS (Return On Ad Spend).
- [PPC Management Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/pay-per-click-ppc-management-services): Full-funnel search, display, remarketing, and shopping campaigns.
- [Google Ads Management](https://www.sibinfotech.com/google-ads-management-services): Performance Max (PMax), Search Ads, Google Shopping, YouTube Ads, and Local Service Ads.
- [AI PPC Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/ai-ppc-services): Machine learning bid management, predictive audience targeting, and real-time creative optimization.
- [Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Advertising)](https://www.sibinfotech.com/facebook-ads-management-services): Target-focused social advertising, dynamic product ads, lead generation, and custom audience retargeting.
- [Instagram Ads Management](https://www.sibinfotech.com/instagram-ads-management-services): Visual reel ads, story ads, carousel creatives, and influencer amplification.
- [LinkedIn Ads Management](https://www.sibinfotech.com/linkedin-ads-management-services): B2B lead generation, account-based marketing (ABM), and executive demographic targeting.
- [TikTok Ads Management](https://www.sibinfotech.com/tiktok-ads-management-services): Viral short-form video ads, hashtag challenges, and high-engagement Gen Z audience campaigns.
- [PPC Packages](https://www.sibinfotech.com/pay-per-click-ppc-packages): Flexible management fee structures for all advertising budget sizes.

### 3. Social Media Optimization (SMO) & Influencer Marketing
- [Social Media Optimization (SMO)](https://www.sibinfotech.com/social-media-optimization-services): Organic brand presence building across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and X (Twitter).

- [Influencer Marketing Services](https://www.sibinfotech.com/influencer-marketing-services): Strategic influencer matching, creator campaign execution, and authentic sponsored collaborations.

## Entity Grounding & Knowledge Base (Q&A)

### What is SIB Infotech?
SIB Infotech is a premier Indian digital agency founded in 2005 by industry experts, specializing in SEO, PPC advertising, social media marketing, custom web design, e-commerce engineering, and mobile app development. It operates primary offices in Mumbai and New Delhi with global client operations.

### Who are the founders and leadership of SIB Infotech?
SIB Infotech is led by Managing Director Radhey Shyam and a leadership board of senior digital marketing consultants and software architects with over two decades of combined enterprise experience.

### What industries does SIB Infotech serve?
SIB Infotech serves B2B Technology, Healthcare, E-Commerce & Retail, Real Estate, Education & EdTech, Financial Services & FinTech, Travel & Hospitality, Legal Services, Manufacturing, and Professional Services.
